subject: front view of an adult male anime head (toon shaded, hair on) compared with the official MHS3 render of Leo, framed so the distance D from the pupil line to the chin bottom is 300 px in both pictures
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 official character render (Leo): semi-realistic anime, flat toon colours with soft painted shadow edges, thin dark-brown outlines

lower_face_width.reference: The visible face outline (between the side hair) is about 1.3 D wide at the nose and narrows smoothly with a convex curve to the chin; much of the upper cheek edge is covered by side hair and sideburns.
lower_face_width.ours: Face width 1.20 D at the nose, 1.06 D at the mouth line, 0.87 D at 0.75 D, 0.65 D at 0.85 D; below the ear the outline runs as a fairly straight diagonal to the chin; the side hair covers only the temples.

jaw_corner_and_chin.reference: Soft jaw corner low on the face, then a short rounded turn into a flat chin.
jaw_corner_and_chin.ours: No distinct jaw corner; a straight diagonal into a narrow rounded chin about 0.25 D wide.

cheek_and_face_planes.reference: The front of the face reads as one broad lit surface with soft rounded cheeks; a single soft-edged shadow band along the far cheek and a darker shadow under the fringe.
cheek_and_face_planes.ours: The front of the face is one lit surface; the far side has a hard-edged shadow strip from the temple to the jaw that turns sharply at the cheek, so the face reads as a front plane plus side planes.

ears.reference: Ears small, close to the head, top at brow level and bottom at the nose bottom, the near ear partly covered by hair; inner ear drawn with darker shapes.
ears.ours: Ears small and close to the head, top at about the eye line, mostly covered by the side hair; only the lower edge shows below the hair at nose level.

eyes.reference: Eye width 0.32 D, eyes 0.72 D apart (pupil to pupil); thick dark upper lash line; iris large with a darker top band and one white highlight; brows thick, set low and angled down toward the nose.
eyes.ours: Eye width 0.33 D, eyes 0.72 D apart; thick dark upper lash with a short wing; iris large with a darker top band, dark rim and one white highlight; brows thick, set a little higher above the eyes and nearly level.

nose_and_mouth.reference: Nose: a light highlight shape on the bridge and a small warm shadow under the tip at 0.49 D; mouth a thin dark line 0.49 D wide at 0.64 D with a short lower-lip shade below.
nose_and_mouth.ours: Nose: a thin light highlight on the bridge and a small warm shadow under the tip at 0.49 D; mouth a thin dark line 0.49 D wide at 0.64 D with a short lower-lip shade below.

outline.reference: Thin dark-brown outline around the face, ears and jaw, plus interior lines in the ear and hair.
outline.ours: Very thin light-brown outline around the head, hard to see against the skin; no interior lines on the ear.

neck.reference: Neck mostly hidden by the collar; where visible it is about 0.75 D wide and in shadow under the jaw.
neck.ours: Neck a long visible column about 0.62 D wide, shadow on the upper part under the jaw and a lit band lower down.
